title: Introducing ChatGPT Pulse
summary: Today we’re releasing a preview of ChatGPT Pulse to Pro users on mobile. Pulse is a new experience where ChatGPT proactively does research to deliver personalized updates based on your chats, feedback, and connected apps like your calendar.
body: Today we’re releasing a preview of ChatGPT Pulse to Pro users on mobile. Pulse is a new experience where ChatGPT proactively does research to deliver personalized updates based on your chats, feedback, and connected apps like your calendar.
summaryZh: OpenAI在移动端向Pro用户推出了ChatGPT Pulse预览版。该功能通过主动整合用户的聊天记录、反馈以及日历等关联应用数据，自动进行研究并提供个性化的信息更新。这一更新标志着ChatGPT从传统的被动问答模式向主动式智能助手转型，旨在通过更深度的上下文感知提升用户体验。

aiReview.reasonZh: ChatGPT Pulse引入了主动式AI交互模式，通过整合用户数据提供个性化更新，代表了AI从被动响应向主动服务的演进。
